practiceSets.title: Talking About Hobbies and Free Time
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about what you enjoy doing when you are not working or studying.

mcqQuestions.stemText: I like to ___ old coins from different countries.
My sister plays a musical ___ very well.
I usually ___ on the sofa after a long day at work.
She is very ___ and loves painting pictures.
Photography is a great ___ if you like taking pictures.
When it rains, I prefer doing activities ___.
My brother won the tennis ___ last week.
I ___ a lot of time reading books on the weekend.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe your favorite hobby. Explain how you started doing it and how often you practice it now.
Do you prefer hobbies that you can do indoors or outdoors? Tell me about why you like that kind of activity.

practiceSets.title: Describing a Recent Trip or Journey
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about a holiday or travel experience you had recently.

mcqQuestions.stemText: I packed all my clothes into a large ___.
You must show your ___ before you get on the airplane.
We went ___ in the city and saw many famous buildings.
I bought a small ___ to remember my trip to Paris.
The train was late, so we had a long ___ at the station.
We decided to ___ the old town and walk through the small streets.
The ___ from my house to the airport takes one hour.
I lost my plane ___ and could not get on the flight.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe a recent trip you took. Tell me where you went, who you traveled with, and how you got there.
Tell me about the best part of your journey. Why was this experience so special or important to you?

practiceSets.title: Your Dream Job
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about the kind of work you would love to do in the future.

mcqQuestions.stemText: My brother earns a very good ___ at his new job.
The shop assistant was very polite to the ___.
Nurses and police officers have to wear a ___ at work.
If you want to be a designer, you need to be very ___.
The ___ told everyone what to do in the meeting.
I want to learn new computer ___ for my career.
A good secretary is always very ___ and keeps everything tidy.
My father works in a large ___ in the city center.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe the kind of job you would like to have in the future. Explain what you would do every day and why you want this job.
Do you think it is more important to earn a lot of money or to be happy at work? Explain your reasons.

practiceSets.title: Health and Exercise Habits
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about how you stay fit and the healthy choices you make.

mcqQuestions.stemText: Eating fruit and vegetables is very ___.
I go to the ___ three times a week to lift weights.
You need to ___ your arms and legs before you run.
Drinking a lot of water is a good ___.

The doctor gave me some ___ for my headache.
If you want to lose weight, you should change your ___.
My grandfather is 80 years old, but he is still very ___.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe what you do to stay healthy and active. Talk about the food you eat and the exercise you do.
Tell me about a time when you were sick or hurt. How did you feel, and what did you do to get better?

practiceSets.title: Shopping and Money
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about buying things, prices, and how you manage your money.

mcqQuestions.stemText: This watch was very ___, so I did not buy it.
I got a 20% ___ on these shoes because they were on sale.
Please keep the ___ in case you want to return the shirt.

I cannot ___ to buy a new car this year.
Can I ___ ten dollars from you? I will pay you back tomorrow.
The store only accepts ___ today, no credit cards.
The ___ was very unhappy with the bad service.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe a place where you usually go shopping. Explain what you buy there and why you like this shop.
Tell me about a time you bought something that cost a lot of money. Do you think it was a good idea to buy it?

practiceSets.title: Comparing Two Places You Know
practiceSets.description: Practice describing the differences between two cities, towns, or neighborhoods.

mcqQuestions.stemText: New York is very ___; there are people everywhere.
The village is very ___, with no loud cars or traffic.
This city has very ___ buildings made of glass.
My hometown is very ___; people still wear old-style clothes.

There is a lot of ___ on the roads in the morning.
The ___ between my house and the school is two kilometers.
I do not like living near the airport because it is too ___.

speakingTasks.prompt: Compare your hometown with another city or town you have visited. Describe how the buildings, people, and streets are different.
Do you prefer living in a busy, modern city or a quiet, traditional village? Tell me the reasons for your choice.

practiceSets.title: Describing a Friend or Family Member
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about people you are close to, their appearance, and personality.

mcqQuestions.stemText: My aunt is very ___; she loves talking to everyone.
A person who always tells the truth is ___.
My best friend is very ___; she always gives me great presents.
He is a very ___ student who never laughs in class.
My brother is so ___; he always makes me laugh.
A cousin is a type of ___ in your family.
She is very ___ and always smiles at new people.
He is very ___; he always helps me clean the house.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe a close friend or a family member. Tell me what they look like and describe their personality.
Tell me about a time when this friend or family member helped you with a big problem or an important task.

practiceSets.title: Technology in Daily Life
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about phones, computers, and how you use the internet.

mcqQuestions.stemText: I need to charge my phone because the ___ is low.

I sent a text ___ to my friend to say I was late.
I cannot ___ my laptop to the Wi-Fi in the cafe.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe how you use technology, such as your mobile phone or computer, on a normal day.
Do you think people today spend too much time looking at screens? Explain why you feel this way.

practiceSets.title: Food and Eating Habits
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about cooking, favorite dishes, and trying different foods.

mcqQuestions.stemText: This soup is very ___; it has a lot of chili peppers.

I was hungry, so I ate an apple as a quick ___.
This pasta is absolutely ___; I love it!
Sushi is a ___ food from Japan.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe your favorite meal of the day. Explain what you usually eat and drink, and who cooks it.
Tell me about a time you tried a completely new kind of food or dish. Did you enjoy eating it or not? Explain why.

practiceSets.title: Transportation and Getting Around
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about trains, buses, traffic, and commuting to places.

mcqQuestions.stemText: There were 50 ___ waiting on the bus.

I lock my ___ outside the shop when I go in.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe the transport you usually use to get to work or school. Tell me how long the journey takes and what you see on the way.
Do you prefer traveling long distances by train, bus, or car? Explain the reasons for your choice.

practiceSets.title: Weekend Plans and Activities
practiceSets.description: Practice discussing how you organize your weekends and what you do for fun.

mcqQuestions.stemText: We need to ___ a meeting for next Saturday.

I like ___ activities like hiking and playing football.

I want to ___ all my friends to my birthday party.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe what you usually do on a typical weekend. Explain who you spend time with and how you choose to relax.
Tell me about a very special weekend you had recently. What activities did you do, and what made it so good?

practiceSets.title: Describing a Celebration or Holiday
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about festivals, parties, and cultural events you enjoy.

mcqQuestions.stemText: We clean and ___ our house before the New Year.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe an important holiday or festival in your country. Explain how people prepare for it and how they celebrate.
Tell me about the best party or celebration you went to last year. Who was there and what made it so fun?

practiceSets.title: Learning Something New
practiceSets.description: Practice talking about studying, gaining new skills, and the challenges of learning.

mcqQuestions.stemText: I need to ___ speaking English every day.
If you are a ___, you are just starting to learn.

speakingTasks.prompt: Describe a new skill or hobby you are learning right now. Explain what you do to practice and why you chose to learn it.
Do you think it is easier to learn something new when you are a child or when you are an adult? Tell me why.
